attributes.action: Reform London ULEZ: Stop the £180 fine money-making scam and fix unclear signage
attributes.additional_details: We call on the Government to reform London’s ULEZ cash-grab scam. Innocent drivers face an unfair £180 fine due to unclear boundary signage. ULEZ has cut pollution by only 27% since 2019, which fails to justify this financial hardship. Ministers must demand clear signs and scrap automatic fines.
attributes.background: The scheme is a cash grab trapping innocent drivers with an unfair £180 fine due to unclear signs. It has cut pollution by only 27% since 2019. Government must step in, clear the signage, and scrap automatic fines.

rejection.details:
We can only accept petitions about things the Government or Parliament are directly responsible for.

Decisions about the ULEZ in London are a matter for the Mayor of London and Transport for London, not the UK Government or Parliament.

We also can’t accept petitions that call for action at a local level.

You could raise your concerns with a local councillor who represents you. You can use this page to find out who your local councillors are, and how to contact them: https://www.gov.uk/find-your-local-councillors
